capabilities: run Pomodoro work, short break, and long break sessions from the pane header
start, pause, resume, and reset the timer via hover controls
customize session durations and sessions before a long break
auto-start breaks and work sessions after each completes
notify via desktop notifications and sound alerts
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Pomodoro timer, so users who want timed focus sessions inside their workspace must use an external app or interrupt their workflow.
summary: Minimal Pomodoro timer that shows a circular countdown in the pane header with configurable work and break sessions.
